name: GPS/LTE/CBRS/WiFi 9 Element Indoor/Outdoor Omni Antenna with SMA and RPSMA
polarization: GPS: Right Hand Circular / LTE: Linear / WiFi: Linear
mount_type: Threaded bolt with nut

field_notes.frequency_range: Hubbell prints 698-960/1575.42-1610/1710-2690/3300-3800/2400-2483 with no units. AccelTex splits GPS 1575.42-1610 MHz, cellular 698-960/1710-2690/3300-3800 MHz, and Wi-Fi 2.4-2.483/4.9-5.825 GHz. The Hubbell string does not include a 5 GHz Wi-Fi range; the AccelTex Wi-Fi plot legend shows 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.
field_notes.gain_dbi: Hubbell lists GPS 25 dBi, LTE 3 dBi, WiFi 2 dBi. AccelTex lists GPS gain as 25 dB (with noise figure <1.5 dB), cellular 3 dBi, and Wi-Fi 2 dBi.
field_notes.beamwidth: Hubbell lists horizontal 360° and vertical 90°/70°/90° without assigning the three vertical numbers to GPS, LTE, or Wi-Fi.
field_notes.vswr: Hubbell prints <2.0-3.0. AccelTex splits GPS ≤2.0, cellular ≤3.0, and Wi-Fi ≤2.5.
field_notes.connector: Hubbell title says SMA and RPSMA and Number of Leads is 9. AccelTex lists 5 SMA (1 GPS and 4 LTE/CBRS) and 4 RPSMA (Wi-Fi).
field_notes.cable_type: Hubbell lists RG174. AccelTex lists ATS-100. Primary value uses Hubbell.
field_notes.cable_length: Hubbell lists 457 mm. AccelTex lists 18 in. 18 in is 457 mm.
field_notes.dimensions: AccelTex lists 5.1 in diameter × 2.6 in H. Hubbell lists Length 5.1 in, Height 2.6 in, Width 0 in.
field_notes.radome: ABS is on the AccelTex sheet only.
field_notes.indoor_outdoor: Hubbell Indoor/Outdoor field and the AccelTex environment line say Outdoor. The Hubbell title says Indoor/Outdoor.
field_notes.patterns: Service names in the filenames are the AccelTex headings (Wi-Fi, Cellular/CBRS, GPS). Each plot is one orientation.
